We've got four high-load activities that need to be scheduled across today's four two-hour blocks between 0800 and 1600: the generator load test, clinic refrigeration transfer, communications-battery recharge, and water-point pumping. As you all know, the main generator can only support one of these at a time, so each activity gets its own block. Before I publish the final schedule, I need each section to report any changes or constraints that might affect the ordering. Let's go around the room -- what's changed since last time?
